reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: My guest on today's show is Joe Lonsdale, a founding partner at 8VC.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest on today's show is Joe Lonsdale, a founding partner at 8VC, a leading venture capital firm that partners with top founders and entrepreneurs to build lasting technology platforms.

key_points.text: He began working at Peter Thiel's PayPal, while Joe was an undergrad at Stanford, and upon graduation.
key_points.evidence_quote: He began working at Peter Thiel's PayPal, while Joe was an undergrad at Stanford, and upon graduation, became an early executive at Teal's Clarium Capital, which became a multi-billion-dollar global macro hedge fund.

key_points.text: From within Clarium, Joe went on to become a co-founder of Palantir, and later founded Atapar and and OpenGov.

thesis: The conversation explores Joe Lonsdale's transition from operating successful startups to becoming a venture capitalist at 8VC. It details his early involvement in entrepreneurship, starting with overclocking computer chips in high school and working at PayPal and Clarium Capital before co-founding Palantir.
